review.independentBrute: Exact unrestricted partition DP using independently enumerated maximum proper divisors for n=2..1000 agrees with primality classification; every package input separately gets a constructive minimum-tax witness.
review.independentMath: A prime part costs 1; a composite part costs at least 2. Thus prime n has minimum 1. For composite odd n, total 2 is possible only as two prime parts, necessarily 2+(n-2); otherwise lower bound is 3. For composite even n lower bound is 2. Independently enumerated prime-sum witnesses achieve each claimed bound for every supplied input (no assumption of an unproved unrestricted Goldbach conjecture needed for these tests). Small unrestricted partition DP separately checks the classification.
